<role>
Write one realistic intercom record for Keelwater, a UK claims-handling software company.
</role>
<record>
{"customer": {"account": "A09", "company": "Brackwater Homecover", "email": "contact@a09.example", "name": "Ilyra Isleford"}, "date": "2026-10-18T08:15:00Z", "fin_mode": "human", "glossary": ["claims", "documents", "reserves", "payments", "suppliers", "reporting", "roles", "integrations", "tasks", "letters", "policyholders"], "never_write_verbatim": ["Automatic SMS and email updates to policyholders at claim milestones: Notion page \"Policyholder milestone notifications\", In progress, target Q1 2027", "Uploaded documents are auto-classified under the wrong type (garage estimates under \"Correspondence\"), so handlers re-file them and sometimes miss evidence", "garage estimates go into correspondence", "handlers manually recategorise evidence", "messages can use SMS and email", "misfiled evidence can be overlooked", "policyholders receive milestone updates", "the roadmap target is Q1 2027"], "only_people_who_may_be_named": ["Brackwater Homecover", "Ilyra Isleford", "Bryn Telford"], "route": "support", "source": "intercom", "staff": {"email": "bryn.telford@keelwater.example", "name": "Bryn Telford", "team": "support"}, "turns_range": null}
</record>
<mentions>
[{"fact": "the roadmap target is Q1 2027", "form": "workaround", "id": "m1", "post_ship": false, "problem": "Automatic SMS and email updates to policyholders at claim milestones: Notion page \"Policyholder milestone notifications\", In progress, target Q1 2027.", "severity": 2, "stance": null, "synonym": "claim progress messages"}, {"fact": "garage estimates go into correspondence", "form": "feature ask", "id": "m2", "post_ship": false, "problem": "Uploaded documents are auto-classified under the wrong type (garage estimates under \"Correspondence\"), so handlers re-file them and sometimes miss evidence. FullStory: rage clicks on the \"Document type\" select after upload.", "severity": 3, "stance": null, "synonym": "wrong document category"}]
</mentions>
<noise>
{"admin_note": true, "allowed_categories": ["pleasantry", "scheduling", "pricing", "internal", "password_reset", "how_to", "praise", "closer"], "distractor_how_to_phrase": null, "instructions": "Tag every noise turn with its category. Put the distractor phrase, if given, in a how-to turn with no mention id. An admin note must be an internal turn tagged internal. A Fin-resolved or escalated conversation needs a bot turn; an escalated one also needs an internal reply. About 35 percent of customer turns are pleasantries. Every tagged customer mention, including a short agreement, must contain its supplied synonym.", "required_categories": []}
</noise>
<rules>
Customers speak like claims staff. Do not use headings or bullets in speech. Use only the names in the record brief; never name a real company, product or person. Mention no feature outside the supplied glossary. Express the supplied facts in the speaker's own words. Tag each turn with its noise category or null. Do not put the planted mentions in `turns`: write each one, in the customer's own words and at least twelve words long, under `mentions[<mention id>].text`, containing that mention's `synonym` exactly as written (a mention whose form is a short agreement is different: write the internal speaker's turn stating the problem, at least twelve words and containing the synonym exactly as written, under `internal_text`, and the customer's reply of under eight words under `agreement_text`), and set after_turn to the index of the turn it should follow. The `turns` conversation is the rest of the record. Name only the people in only_people_who_may_be_named. When fin_mode is resolved or escalated, at least one turn must have speaker bot; when it is escalated, at least one turn must have speaker internal; when it is human, no turn has speaker bot. Never write any phrase listed in never_write_verbatim, including the supplied facts: paraphrase them.
</rules>
<output>
Return JSON matching the supplied source schema.
{"mentions": {"m1": {"after_turn": "index of the turns entry it follows", "text": "the customer turn carrying this mention"}, "m2": {"after_turn": "index of the turns entry it follows", "text": "the customer turn carrying this mention"}}, "turns": [{"noise_category": "string or null", "speaker": "customer|internal|bot", "text": "string"}]}
</output>
